name: Admissibility Phase Transition Law
purpose: Define abrupt topology reorganization under admissibility-threshold crossing.

candidate_law_statement.informal: A metastable continuation regime may undergo sudden reorganization when accumulated admissibility pressure crosses a transition threshold.

formal.transition_pressure_candidate: P_T(M_U) := F(boundary_pressure, budget_depletion, perturbation_load, reinforcement_decay, basin_competition)
formal.phase_transition_condition: PhaseShift(M_U) may occur when P_T(M_U) ≥ Θ_T(M_U) under declared transition tolerance.
formal.avalanche_condition: Avalanche(M_U) may occur when transition of one basin/channel propagates instability through shared accessibility, budget, or reinforcement dependencies.
formal.topology_reorganization_condition: Reorganize(Top_A(U)) may occur when prior accessibility relations no longer preserve admissibility-compatible continuation.
formal.regime_shift_condition: RegimeShift(M_U → M_V) may occur when one metastable law-like regime loses validity and another stabilizes.
